## Professional focus

- Applied AI workflow design
- AI deployment and enablement
- Agent operations and long-session reliability
- Human-in-the-loop authority boundaries

- Retail POS and payment operations

## Operating principles

1. Human authority: consequential decisions remain under explicit human control.
2. Evidence over confidence: runtime results, screenshots, files, tests, Git state, and user confirmation outrank model claims.
3. Context before intelligence: trustworthy retrieval, relationships, state, and source boundaries come before model reasoning.
4. Least necessary autonomy: agents receive only the authority required for the workflow.
5. Visible failure paths: uncertainty, tool errors, missing context, and partial execution should surface clearly.
6. Durable handoffs: important state must survive the individual chat or agent session.

## Selected systems

### AuditME / CodexSystem
https://sinisterj12.github.io/projects/auditme-codexsystem.html
AI reliability and agent-operations workflow for durable repository context, verification receipts, branch discipline, closeout gates, and clean handoffs between long AI-assisted build sessions.

### Manager
https://sinisterj12.github.io/projects/manager.html
Human-controlled AI project management system focused on durable context, useful next actions, evidence-backed progress, explicit uncertainty, and a strict distinction between model assistance and human authority.

### WorkDock
https://sinisterj12.github.io/projects/workdock.html
Windows-first Google Workspace command center used as a private daily-driver. It combines Gmail, Sheets, Docs, Drive, Calendar, Meet, Chat, local files, Google Drive destinations, and context-aware notes while keeping session, privacy, and data-capture boundaries explicit.

### RDSCore
https://sinisterj12.github.io/projects/rdscore.html
Search-first support operations workspace shaped by live helpdesk pressure. A graph-backed context layer connects organizations, stores, tickets, contacts, and ownership so retrieval and AI assistance can work from relationships instead of disconnected records.

## Public repositories

https://github.com/Sinisterj12/PQManager
Windows utility shaped by real NCR virtual-terminal print queue stability problems in retail support environments.

### Gping
https://github.com/Sinisterj12/Gping
Go-based network diagnostics work shaped by payment and support troubleshooting needs.
